spectators.label: Dog-man in a business suit
spectators.look: anthropomorphic brown dog-man with long floppy ears, a black nose and an eager tongue-out face, wearing a navy business suit, a white shirt with a red tie and black shoes, carrying a brown leather briefcase
spectators.idle: briefcase held in front, tail wagging
spectators.cheer: briefcase raised high, barking happily
spectators.shocked: ears flipped straight up, tongue hanging out

spectators.label: Cat lady in a cardigan
spectators.look: graceful grey tabby cat-woman with bright green eyes, pointed ears and white whiskers, wearing pearl earrings, a pink cardigan over a cream blouse and a long brown skirt, a small red handbag on her arm
spectators.idle: paws folded, tail curling, watching with half-closed eyes
spectators.cheer: one paw up waving, tail straight up
spectators.shocked: fur puffed out, tail bristled, eyes huge

spectators.label: Rabbit kid with a carrot
spectators.look: small white rabbit boy with long upright ears, pink nose and buck teeth, wearing blue overalls over a yellow tee, holding a half-eaten orange carrot
spectators.idle: munching the carrot, ears twitching
spectators.cheer: hopping high with the carrot raised
spectators.shocked: ears drooping flat, carrot dropped

spectators.label: Boar farmer with a potato sack
spectators.look: big burly boar-man with bristly dark-brown fur, curved white tusks and a flat pink snout, wearing a frayed straw hat and faded blue dungarees over a white undershirt, a lumpy burlap sack of potatoes over one shoulder
spectators.idle: sack on his shoulder, snorting contentedly
spectators.cheer: free arm out to the side, snorting loudly
spectators.shocked: sack slipping, potatoes rolling, tusks agape

spectators.label: Bird mail carrier
spectators.look: slender blue-feathered bird-man with a yellow beak, a fluffy head crest and round black eyes, wearing a grey mail carrier jacket with brass buttons, a peaked grey cap and a brown leather satchel stuffed with blank envelopes
spectators.idle: satchel strap clutched, head tilted at the ring
spectators.cheer: wings spread with a few envelopes fluttering out
spectators.shocked: feathers ruffled out, crest standing on end

spectators.label: Lizard punk
spectators.look: wiry green lizard-man with yellow slit eyes, a long tail and a tall spiky red head crest shaped like a mohawk, wearing a studded black leather jacket over a ripped white tank top, black jeans, a silver chain and combat boots
spectators.idle: slouching, tongue flicking, sneering at the ring
spectators.cheer: rock-horn hand sign thrown up, hissing a cheer
spectators.shocked: head crest flared wide, jaw hanging open

spectators.label: Bear lumberjack with a honey jar
spectators.look: huge black bear-man with a tan muzzle and small friendly eyes, wearing a red-and-black plaid flannel shirt with rolled sleeves, brown suspenders and work pants, cradling a big clay jar of honey with a wooden dipper
spectators.idle: licking honey off his paw, watching
spectators.cheer: both arms out wide to the sides, roaring
spectators.shocked: honey jar tipping, dipper stuck in his open mouth

spectators.label: Pig chef with a ladle
spectators.look: round pink pig-man with a curly tail and a jolly snout, wearing a tall white chef's hat, a white double-breasted chef's coat with a red neckerchief and checked trousers, holding a big steel ladle
spectators.idle: tapping the ladle against his palm, tasting the air
spectators.cheer: ladle swung overhead, oinking happily
spectators.shocked: chef's hat flying off, ladle dropped

spectators.label: Cow grocer lady
spectators.look: sturdy black-and-white spotted cow-woman with small curved horns, long eyelashes and a cowbell on a ribbon at her neck, wearing a yellow headscarf and a green apron over a white blouse, holding a glass milk bottle
spectators.idle: milk bottle hugged to her chest, mooing softly
spectators.cheer: milk bottle raised in a toast, bell clanging
spectators.shocked: eyelashes fluttering wide, milk bottle slipping

spectators.label: Monkey street performer
spectators.look: nimble brown monkey with a long curling tail and a toothy grin, wearing a small red fez with a gold tassel and a red vest with gold trim over bare fur, holding a pair of brass hand cymbals
spectators.idle: tapping the cymbals lightly, tail swaying
spectators.cheer: crashing the cymbals together above his head
spectators.shocked: cymbals stuck to his ears, eyes popping

spectators.label: Fox fortune teller
spectators.look: sly orange fox-woman with a big white-tipped bushy tail and narrow amber eyes, wearing a purple fringed shawl over a dark-blue dress, gold hoop earrings and bangles, holding a small glowing crystal ball
spectators.idle: gazing into the crystal ball with a knowing smile
spectators.cheer: crystal ball held high, tail swishing
spectators.shocked: tail puffed huge, crystal ball nearly dropped

spectators.label: Frog ukulele player
spectators.look: squat bright-green frog-man with huge bulging eyes and a wide smile, wearing a straw boater hat, a red bow tie and a red-and-white striped blazer over white trousers, strumming a small tan ukulele
spectators.idle: strumming the ukulele, swaying
spectators.cheer: ukulele held up, throat sac puffed out croaking
spectators.shocked: eyes bulging even wider, boater hat bouncing up

spectators.label: Wolf mechanic
spectators.look: lean grey wolf-man with a shaggy neck ruff, sharp yellow eyes and a scar on one ear, wearing oil-stained mustard-yellow overalls with rolled sleeves and brass work goggles pushed up on his forehead, carrying a big steel wrench
spectators.idle: wrench resting on his shoulder, watching with a grin
spectators.cheer: wrench held out to the side, howling
spectators.shocked: goggles dropped over his eyes, ears pinned back

spectators.label: Penguin waiter
spectators.look: plump black-and-white penguin with a bright orange beak and feet, wearing a red bow tie and a white napkin over one flipper, balancing a silver tray with a tall glass of orange soda
spectators.idle: balancing the tray very carefully, watching sidelong
spectators.cheer: flapping the free flipper, tray wobbling
spectators.shocked: soda glass tipping off the tray, beak wide open

spectators.label: Tiger wrestler
spectators.look: massive muscular tiger-man with orange fur, bold black stripes and a white muzzle, wearing a purple wrestling singlet, white wrist tape and black wrestling boots
spectators.idle: arms crossed over his chest, tail flicking
spectators.cheer: arms out wide to the sides, roaring with fangs bared
spectators.shocked: fur standing on end, ears flat, jaw dropped

spectators.label: Mouse girl with a cheese snack
spectators.look: tiny grey mouse girl with huge round pink-lined ears, a thin tail and shiny black eyes, wearing a pink sundress with white dots and a white headband bow, nibbling a yellow wedge of cheese
spectators.idle: nibbling the cheese wedge, ears perked
spectators.cheer: cheese held up high, squeaking
spectators.shocked: ears straight back, cheese dropped, whiskers quivering

spectators.label: Crocodile boss in pinstripes
spectators.look: smug green crocodile-man with a long toothy snout and heavy-lidded eyes, wearing a white pinstripe suit, a black shirt with a red tie, a white fedora, dark round sunglasses and a gold chain, a thick tail swishing behind
spectators.idle: hands in pockets, smirking with a toothy grin
spectators.cheer: fedora waved out to the side, laughing
spectators.shocked: sunglasses sliding, long jaw hanging wide open

spectators.label: Sheep granny with a thermos
spectators.look: soft round sheep-lady with a cloud of white wool, curled tan horns and sleepy eyes, wearing a lilac knitted shawl and a long grey skirt, holding a red tartan thermos of tea
spectators.idle: pouring tea into the thermos cap, eyes on the ring
spectators.cheer: thermos lifted high, baaing happily
spectators.shocked: wool puffed out double size, tea splashing

spectators.label: Owl scholar with books
spectators.look: studious brown owl with big round orange eyes behind wire spectacles and feathery ear tufts, wearing a dark-green academic robe with a tasseled square cap, carrying a stack of thick leather-bound books
spectators.idle: books under one wing, head tilted, observing
spectators.cheer: books raised high, hooting
spectators.shocked: eyes blown huge, feathers puffed out, books toppling

spectators.label: Fawn schoolgirl
spectators.look: shy young fawn girl with light-brown fur, white speckles on her shoulders, big dark eyes and long ears, a red ribbon tied in her short hair, wearing a green sailor-collar school uniform with a white neckerchief and a brown leather school satchel
spectators.idle: holding the satchel strap with both hands, watching nervously
spectators.cheer: jumping with both hands up, ears perked
spectators.shocked: ears flat back, hands over her mouth
